title: Learn Two Key Texas Hold'em Terms: Bluff and Fold
summaryJa: テキサスホールデムで最も重要な2つの用語「ブラフ」と「フォールド」を紹介します。ブラフは弱いハンドで勝つために賭ける戦略で、フォールドはゲームから降りることです。これらの言葉を理解することは、ポーカープレイヤーにとって基本的です。
segments: Texas Hold'em has many special words. Two important words are "bluff" and "fold".
Learning these words helps you understand poker better. Many new players need to learn what they mean.
A "bluff" is when you bet money and act strong, but your cards are not good. You want other players to think you have a winning hand.
For example, you have very bad cards. You bet a lot of money anyway.
Other players see your big bet. They think you have strong cards.
So they stop playing. You win the money without showing your cards.
This is a bluff. A "fold" means you stop playing the hand.
You give up your cards. You do not put more money in the pot.
Folding is a smart choice when your cards are weak. For example, you have two low cards.
The player next to you bets a lot of money. You think you cannot win.
So you fold. You stop playing that hand.
Now you save your money. Bluffing and folding are very different.
When you bluff, you stay in the game and bet. When you fold, you leave the game.
Good poker players know when to bluff and when to fold. They use both skills to win money.
